cards.text:
[click]: Shuffle 15 Minutes into R&D. The Corp can trigger this ability while 15 Minutes is in the Runner's score area.
Limit 1 per deck.
cards.title: 15 Minutes

cards.text:
As an additional cost to play 24/7 News Cycle, forfeit an agenda.
Resolve the "when scored" ability on an agenda in your score area.
cards.title: 24/7 News Cycle

cards.text: As an additional cost to play this operation, spend [click]. Install and rez (paying all costs) X advertisements from Archives and/or HQ, if able.
cards.title: Ad Blitz

cards.text: You start the game with 3 different directive cards installed (these cards are not considered part of your deck).
cards.title: Adam: Compulsive Hacker

cards.text: The first [click] you spend each turn must be spent to take the basic action to play an event or the basic action to run a server. You cannot take the action to play an event this way except if you play a run event. Once per turn → Lose [click][click]: Break 1 subroutine.
cards.title: Always Be Running

cards.text: You cannot install non-virtual resources. When your turn begins, you may install 1 card from your grip facedown.
cards.title: Apex: Invasive Predator

cards.text:
Play only if you made a successful run on HQ, R&D and Archives this turn.
Trash all installed Corp cards. Turn all installed Runner cards facedown.
cards.title: Apocalypse

cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this ice in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this ice anywhere except in Archives, you may pay 3[credit]. If you do, they encounter it.
[subroutine] Trace[6]. If successful, add 1 installed Runner card to the grip.
cards.title: Archangel

cards.text:
[subroutine] Trace[5]. If successful, do 3 net damage.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, trash 1 program.
cards.title: Assassin

cards.text: +X[mu] Your maximum hand size is increased by X. X is equal to the number of agenda points you have. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Brain Chip

cards.text: When your turn begins, choose 1 of your installed cards. That card loses its printed abilities for the remainder of the turn.
cards.title: Dr. Lovegood

cards.text: This event is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is scored. The Corp's identity loses its printed abilities.
cards.title: Employee Strike

cards.text: Interface → Trash 1 installed card: Break 1 "[subroutine] End the run." subroutine.
cards.title: Endless Hunger

cards.text: Global Food Initiative is worth 1 fewer agenda point while in the Runner's score area.
cards.title: Global Food Initiative

cards.text:
Install only if you have at least 2[link].
When your turn begins, you may lose [click]. If you do, look at the top card of R&D.
cards.title: Globalsec Security Clearance

cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of barrier subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.title: GS Sherman M3

cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of sentry subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.title: GS Shrike M2

cards.text: If you have at least 2[link], the memory cost of this program is 0[mu], even if it is not installed. Interface → 2[credit]: Break any number of code gate subroutines. 2[credit]: +3 strength.
cards.title: GS Striker M1

cards.text: [interrupt] → When this program would be trashed, turn it facedown instead of adding it to your heap. (It is still considered trashed.)
cards.title: Harbinger

cards.text: +1[mu] [interrupt] → Trash 1 of your installed cards: Prevent 1 damage. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Heartbeat

cards.text: [interrupt], once per turn → 0[credit]: Prevent a "when encountered" ability on a piece of ice. [trash]: Install the top 3 cards of your stack facedown.
cards.title: Hunting Grounds

cards.text: All tracer ice have +1 strength. The base trace strength of each subroutine is increased by 1.
cards.title: Improved Tracers

cards.text: Trash up to 5 of your installed cards. Draw 1 card for each card trashed (or 2 cards for each card trashed if you trashed at least 1 directive).
cards.title: Independent Thinking

cards.text:
Reduce the cost to install Jak Sinclair by 1 for each [link] you have.
When your turn begins, you may make a run. You cannot use programs during this run.
cards.title: Jak Sinclair

cards.text: [trash], remove 1 tag: Trash 1 program. Use this ability only during a run on this server.
cards.title: Keegan Lane

cards.text:
Place 6[credit] from the bank on Launch Campaign when it is rezzed. When there are no credits left on Launch Campaign, trash it.
When your turn begins, take 2[credit] from Launch Campaign.
cards.title: Launch Campaign

cards.text: When you rez Lily Lockwell, draw 3 cards. [click], remove 1 tag: Search R&D for an operation, reveal it, and shuffle the rest of R&D. Add the operation to the top of R&D.
cards.title: Lily Lockwell

cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. Choose an agenda in the Runner's score area. Media Blitz gains the text of that agenda.
cards.title: Media Blitz

cards.text:
2[recurring-credit]
Use these credits to pay for using programs.
cards.title: Multithreader

cards.text:
The first time each turn you access a card with a trash cost, reveal it. You must trash that card by paying its trash cost, if able.
Whenever you breach HQ, access 1 additional card.
cards.title: Neutralize All Threats

cards.text: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, you may play 1 current from HQ or Archives (paying its play cost).
cards.title: New Angeles Sol: Your News

cards.text: [subroutine] Trace[3]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag. If a current is active, this ice gains "[subroutine] End the run." after its other subroutines.
cards.title: News Hound

cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this asset in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this asset, they must either take 2 tags or add this asset to their score area as an agenda worth -1 agenda point.
cards.title: News Team

cards.text: Make a run. Once during this run, when you pass a piece of ice, you may trash a number of your installed cards equal to the strength of that ice. If you do, trash that ice.
cards.title: Prey

cards.text:
While the Runner is accessing this agenda in R&D, they must reveal it.
When the Runner accesses this agenda while they are tagged, add it to your score area.
cards.title: Quantum Predictive Model

cards.text:
When you rez this asset, take 1 bad publicity.
When your turn begins, if the Runner is tagged, gain 2[credit]. Otherwise, gain 1[credit].
cards.title: Reality Threedee

cards.text: All assets gain advertisement.
cards.title: Rebranding Team

cards.text:
Resistor has +1 strength for each tag the Runner has.
[subroutine] Trace[4]. If successful, end the run.
cards.title: Resistor

cards.text: The base trace strength of each trace during a run on this server is increased by 2. Limit 1 region per server.
cards.title: Rutherford Grid

cards.text:
Your maximum hand size is reduced by 2.
When your turn ends, draw 1 card if you do not have cards in your grip equal to or greater than your maximum hand size.
cards.title: Safety First

cards.text: [trash]: Choose an icebreaker (or any number of cloud icebreakers). Each chosen icebreaker has +1 strength for each [link] you have for the remainder of this run. Use this ability only during a run.
cards.title: Security Chip

cards.text: +1[mu], +1[link] Once per turn → When you encounter a piece of ice, you may have the Corp trace[5]. If successful, they give you 1 tag and end the run. If unsuccesful, bypass the encountered ice. Limit 1 console per player.
cards.title: Security Nexus

cards.text:
[click]: Draw 1 card from the bottom of R&D.
[trash]: Search R&D or Archives for an agenda and reveal it. Shuffle the rest of R&D if you searched it. Add the agenda to the bottom of R&D.
cards.title: Shannon Claire

cards.text: The first time each turn you rez an advertisement, the Runner loses 1[credit].
cards.title: Spark Agency: Worldswide Reach

cards.text: [subroutine] The Corp gains 5[credit]. Trash Special Offer.
cards.title: Special Offer

cards.text: This card is not trashed until another current is played or an agenda is stolen. The Runner must spend credits first for each trace attempt during a run.
cards.title: Surveillance Sweep

cards.text:
[click]: Flip this identity.
The Runner pays 1[credit] more when spending a [click] to remove a tag (not through a card ability).
Flip side:
[click]: Flip this identity.
You may pay 2[credit] fewer when spending a [click] to trash a resource (not through a card ability).
cards.title: SYNC: Everything, Everywhere

cards.text:
Whenever you install a piece of hardware or a program, place 1[credit] from the bank on Technical Writer.
[click],[trash]: Take all credits from Technical Writer.
cards.title: Technical Writer

cards.text:
Play only if the Runner is tagged.
Trash all installed resources unless the Runner removes 1 bad publicity.
cards.title: The All-Seeing I

cards.text: [subroutine] The next time the Runner encounters a piece of ice during this run, that ice gains a second copy of each of its subroutines (after the original subroutine) for the remainder of that encounter.
cards.title: TL;DR

cards.text:
When the Runner encounters this ice, they lose 1[credit].
[subroutine] Trace[5]. If successful, give the Runner 1 tag.
cards.title: Turnpike

cards.text:
The Runner gets -1 allotted [click] for each of their turns.
When this asset is trashed from anywhere while being accessed, add it to the Runner's score area as an agenda worth 2 agenda points.
cards.title: Victoria Jenkins

cards.text: The first time each turn you trash 1 of your installed cards, gain 1[credit].
cards.title: Wasteland

cards.text: Shuffle your stack. Trash the top card of your stack. Gain X[credit] where X is equal to the install cost of that card.
cards.title: Windfall

"Yes and No."
"Live from New Angeles, this is Lily Lockwell."
No one can bury a story better.

"If I didn't know better, I'd say they got the better end of that deal." -John Masanori

To the worlds sitting on the couch and watching threedee, Rutherford District might as well be all of New Angeles.

"Meantime the hellish tattoo of the heart increased. It grew quicker and quicker, and louder and louder every instant." -Edgar Allan Poe

I AM BECOME DEATH
"There's parts of the Network now that are different from how they used to be. I can't put my finger on it; just something twitching at my ganglion through my BMI." -Reeve
Data goes in. Nothing comes out.
Adam raised the hammer. He was free.
Bioroids have two brains running in parallel, each capable of running sophisticated programming. There are certain advantages to the setup.
The Second Directive requires a bioroid to complete its primary function above all other considerations, save the First Directive.
"You look tore up, kid. Have a seat, I'll fire up the arc welder."
The Third Directive requires a bioroid to preserve its ability to function and report frequently to Haas-Bioroid for repairs and updates.
The First Directive forbids a bioroid from harming, or through inaction allowing harm to befall, a human being.
"Mommy will be home soon, sweetie. She has to kick some ass first."
Fortunately, Globalsec buys them by the case.
Bigger.
Badder.
Boom.
She approached the server, flashed her credentials, and passed straight through. She wondered what it said about her that doing things the legal way felt like cheating.
"I got an early start today...or maybe I forgot to go home last night."
"Are you crazy? We can't send in prisec until the media gets bored and goes home."
She tried to remember who he was. Not that it mattered anymore.
Technically correct: the best kind of correct.
